_comment: Complete mlai-trade config template. Copy to ~/mlai-trade/config/mlai-trade.json and replace placeholders. Never commit the real mlai-trade.json file. The runtime config, config examples, data files, DB files, logs, and sockets are kept private by the CLI: sensitive directories are chmod 0700 and sensitive files are chmod 0600. PID files are runtime metadata and chmod 0644.

providers._comment: Enable at least one provider. Alpaca is implemented today. Use providers.other as the generic enablement map for future provider modules.

alpaca._comment: Alpaca accounts. Names must be unique within Alpaca.

accounts._comment: A paper account. Paper accounts obey configured compliance simulation in a separate paper compliance universe.
accounts.name: paper-main

accounts._comment: Example real-money account. Real accounts share configured tax/compliance blockers across all real provider accounts.
accounts.name: individual-main

fred._comment: FRED API key for S&P 500/VIX/macro features.

tax._comment: Tax residency and estimate inputs. residency_country is one ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code: US/USD, BR/BRL, SG/SGD, or GB/GBP. US uses filing_status and IRS brackets_file. BR uses B3 monthly day-trade/normal-swing rules for Brazilian-market stocks and annual Lei 14.754/2023 15% foreign financial investment netting for non-Brazilian markets. SG uses previous-calendar-year YA basis and resident individual rates for trading/revenue gains; no short/long CGT split. GB uses the 6 April tax year, HMRC same-day/30-day/Section 104 matching, annual exempt amount, and share CGT rates; no short/long share CGT split. Amounts are reported in the selected country's currency; historical FX conversion is not modeled.

unix._comment: Local Unix socket API; see docs/API.md.

ssl._comment: Remote HTTPS/H3 policy. TCP and UDP default to 443.

logging._comment: Component JSONL logs. Archives rotate to logs/archived/.

feeds._comment: Feeds config. Pair correlations are bounded.

scan._comment: Market-data downloader controls. max_concurrent=1 is conservative for rate limits; increase only if the provider plan supports it.

backend._comment: ML backend selection. LSTM supports auto/cpu/mlx/tch. XGBoost and LightGBM support auto/cpu/cuda when compiled with CUDA support. Ridge is CPU-only.

resources._comment: Automatic memory/CPU safety controls. Use auto unless you need reproducible fixed caps. mlai-trade detects usable RAM from macOS sysctl, Linux host/cgroup limits, FreeBSD sysctl, or Unix sysconf fallback, then sizes ML/SQLite limits from memory_budget_percent. cpu_budget_percent is a percentage of all logical CPU capacity: 80 on 16 logical CPUs means a 1280% top-style process CPU budget. It initializes Tokio async workers plus CPU-bound Rayon/ML worker pools; GPU/NPU backends are uncapped. Numeric values override auto. Use 0/unlimited only for LightGBM row caps on hosts with enough RAM.

market._comment: Market clock guardrails. mode=auto uses Alpaca v3 calendar + v3 clock plus local exchange clock. mode=provider uses provider only. mode=local uses local configured schedule only. Alpaca v3 calendar is queried in UTC; timezone controls local exchange-hour guardrails and is stored with DB trade records.

compliance._comment: Hard legal/regulatory floors are compiled into the code, not configured here. blocked_symbols is user/company policy and supports multiple symbols. Input is normalized to uppercase, so meta/Meta/META all match market symbol META. IRS wash-sale days are fixed at 30. This buffer defaults to 1 and cannot be lowered below 1, so replacement buys are blocked for 31 days by default. exit_cooldown_days blocks re-entry after any exit. Stale prediction controls block new buys while allowing exits to continue.

take_profit_confirmation._comment: Wait cycles/min hold; optional trailing exits.
